name: Yoshino Airi
source:
A college sophomore who is a member of their school's tennis club. 

She is a thoughtful, kind and gentle woman. As a result of her kindness, she's a bit of a pushover. Even so, she has a steadfast heart.

Currently, she is the only woman in their tennis club, but her relationship with the other members are well. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/068/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
